profile.headline: Software Developer at 360 View CRM
profile.summary:
I've been a full stack developer in enterprise software for 11 years, with most of my depth on the backend. I've broken production enough times to know exactly how not to, and these days I'm the person who gets pulled in when something is down and it's costing money.

Most of my work has been customer problem resolution, which sounds like support but isn't. It means digging through stored procedures, tracing data through APIs, and figuring out what went wrong in systems that have years of business logic baked into them. The kind of problems where the answer is usually buried three layers deeper than anyone expects.

I've spent a decade at one company, which means I've watched architectural decisions play out long-term. I know which patterns hold up and which ones turn into the bugs nobody wants to touch.

Core technical strengths:
- C# / .NET backend development (11 years)
- T-SQL: complex queries, stored procedures, performance tuning
- Entity Framework and hybrid data access patterns
- WebAPI design, development, and maintenance
- Complex business domain expertise (financial services, regulatory environments)

I use Copilot professionally and Claude Code for personal projects. Having worked with both, Claude Code is the one that's changed how I think about what a single developer can get done.

I'm looking for a full stack or backend role where I can build, not just maintain, at a company that treats AI-assisted development as a real part of the workflow.

Best way to reach me: josh.w.dev@pm.me

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Full stack developer with primary depth in backend, specializing in C#/.NET systems within an enterprise software platform. Primary responsibilities span two tracks: high-priority customer problem resolution (CPR) generating significant billable revenue, and one-time development projects requiring independent technical ownership.

Key contributions:

- Serve as the go-to resource for complex, revenue-critical customer issues, consistently delivering solutions under tight timelines across multiple client environments
- Design and maintain data access layers using T-SQL and Entity Framework, including stored procedure optimization and query performance tuning for production-scale financial data
- Build and extend WebAPI services supporting integrations between internal platforms and client-facing systems
- Diagnose and resolve deeply embedded issues in legacy codebases, reducing recurring support escalations
- Translate ambiguous client-reported problems into concrete technical root causes, bridging the gap between business impact and code-level fixes

Technical environment: C#, .NET Framework/.NET Core, T-SQL (SQL Server), Entity Framework, WebAPI, Git, GitHub Copilot
